images.image_prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable. A dominant protagonist, an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. World: Ancient Egyptian discovery, location: storm-lit shattered mountain shrine. Event: Tidal wave shield, the cat executes one decisive action with one paw dramatically raised, projecting a safe aerodynamic energy shield across a tiny city behind a giant cracked aquarium window as a theatrical water wall towers toward it. Role: speedster in aerodynamic bodysuit, with bright, clearly separated suit colors, streaking motion trails, and no exact costume copy. Expression: dramatically annoyed face. Gesture: one paw dramatically raised. Twist: the enormous city is a living tabletop model, visibly revealed by miniature streets and tiny practical lamps at the base of the wave. Visual hook: towering storm wall. Outcome: the broken landmark locks safely back into place, visibly clicking into a restored shrine silhouette after the water effect parts.
